title: Understand member-visible hosted project counts
when: When comparing the hosted universe switcher, Projects and Billing, or recovering an unavailable count.
need: The hosted universe switcher and Billing read projects.list from each organization’s own Yoke install through the signed-in member’s existing relay. Count active projects visible to that member, including backlog-only and locally adopted projects; exclude retired projects. GitHub webhook bindings are routing records, not project inventory. engine_project_count_unavailable means the inventory is unknown, not zero. Retry once the universe serves; ask an organization administrator to recover the organization’s Yoke connection if needed. Failed count reads do not prevent switching universes.
surface: Hosted universe switcher and Billing; organization-admin connection recovery.
review: Companion Platform item PLAT-227 records landed implementation and passing internal QA; authorized maintainers can read it through internal access. Deployed desktop and 390px comparison remains pending; this is observed implementation, not verified-live.
